---
title: "Privacy"
---

This textbook site (`book.548marjan.com`) is published by **548 Marjan LLC**. It is
separate from the main site at 548marjan.com and its privacy policy.

**Analytics and visitor identification.** When you read the book, our infrastructure
receives limited technical information (such as your IP address, browser type, and
pages viewed). We use a third-party service to identify the **company or
organization** associated with a visitor's IP address, so we can understand which
businesses find the material useful. This is company-level information derived from
your IP address; **we do not use it to identify you personally by name**, and we do
not build an advertising profile of you.

**Questions or requests.** Email <james@548marjan.com> to ask about this notice or to
request that we not associate your organization with your visits.
